title: 第19章 香火灵位那是给咱老祖宗的第20章 大秦武卒张远在此谁来杀我
slug: 骂我朝廷鹰犬我乃大秦武圣
content_zh:
四五个被压在桥边的军卒奔出，紧随张远身后。
盾，枪，刀，弩。
盾护住前身，枪挺上方，长刀横在两侧，弓弩在后压阵。
苍狼战阵。
张远脚步前行，射来的弩箭被身旁军卒舞动圆盾挡住。
他身上气血力量涌动，脚步与身后战卒一致。
瞬间，众人身外仿佛有气劲流转，一丝浑厚力量涌动，加持在他们身上。
战阵之力。
据说军伍战阵乃是以煞气与气血力量调和，聚合战意而成。
最强的战阵，能将组阵军卒之力合一，能让军阵中所有军卒的战力和防御翻越数倍。
当年大秦以军阵起家，军中强者领兵，战卒随行，战阵激发，煞气凝为武魂，屠仙灭魔，纵横无敌。
那等恢弘战阵还有没有流传不知道。
张远现在所知的也就一道苍狼战阵。
此时组阵，他感觉身上力量陡然提升一成。
别小看这一成，对于后天境层次，已经是难以想象的助力。
“杀。”
口中低语，张远长刀挥出。
长刀脱手，直接出阵，刀锋带着凄厉呼啸，斩在前方的厚重大盾上。
“嘭——”
五寸厚的大盾被一击穿透，长刀入盾，扎在持盾燕军胸口，直接透体。

持盾军卒，连着身边两位用肩膀顶着大盾的军卒同时口中吐血，一屁股坐在青石桥上。
这一击，让桥面上的盾墙直接被轰开。
简单，粗暴。
张远以超强的力量，一击就破开敌方防御。
“退——”
燕军穿校尉衣甲的领军战卒口中低吼，手中长枪向着张远当头刺来。
后方，两位军卒手中弩箭也向着张远射来。
其他持盾的军卒拖着盾往后退。
进退有序，军中精锐。
不是遇到张远出手，此地绝对已经失守。
“当——”
“当——”
两根弩箭被张远左手挥拳击飞。
张远脚下不停，右手已经抬到胸前，迎着刺来的长枪枪锋侧面一拳击出。
山岳拳法，断山封岳。
content_en:
Four or five soldiers who were pinned by the bridge ran out and followed Zhang Yuan.
Shield, spear, knife, crossbow.
The shield protects the front body, the spear is held above, the long sword is on both sides, and the crossbow is behind the formation.
Wolf battle formation.
Zhang Yuan stepped forward, and the crossbow arrows fired were blocked by the soldiers beside him, who waved their round shields.
The energy and blood in his body surged, and his steps were consistent with those of the soldiers behind him.
In an instant, there seemed to be energy flowing outside everyone, and a trace of strong power surged up to bless them.
The power of battle formation.
It is said that the military formation is formed by harmonizing the evil spirit and the power of qi and blood to gather the fighting spirit.
The strongest battle formation can combine the power of the soldiers in the formation into one, and can increase the combat power and defense of all soldiers in the formation several times.
At that time, the Great Qin Dynasty started with military formations. The strong men in the army led the troops, and the soldiers accompanied them. The battle formations were activated, and the evil spirits condensed into martial spirits, killing immortals and demons, making them invincible.
I don’t know if that magnificent battle formation is still spread.
All Zhang Yuan knows now is a wolf battle formation.
At this time, he formed a formation, and he felt that his strength suddenly increased by 10%.
Don't underestimate this percentage, it is already an unimaginable help to the acquired level.
"Kill."
With a whisper in his mouth, Zhang Yuan swung his sword.
The long sword was released and went directly into the formation. The blade screamed loudly and struck the thick shield in front.
"Bang——"
The five-inch-thick shield was penetrated by a single blow, and the long knife entered the shield and pierced the chest of Yan Jun who was holding the shield, directly penetrating his body.
The soldier holding the shield, together with the two soldiers beside him who were holding the big shield on their shoulders, vomited blood at the same time and sat down on the bluestone bridge.
This blow caused the shield wall on the bridge to be blown away.
Simple and crude.
Zhang Yuan used his super strength to break through the enemy's defense with one strike.
"Retreat——"
The leading soldier of the Yan army wearing a captain's armor roared lowly, and stabbed Zhang Yuan in the head with a spear in his hand.
From behind, the two soldiers also shot crossbow arrows towards Zhang Yuan.
The other soldiers holding shields dragged their shields back.
Advance and retreat in an orderly manner, and the army is elite.
Had it not been for Zhang Yuan's attack, this place would have definitely been lost.
"When——"
"When——"
The two crossbow arrows were knocked away by Zhang Yuan's left hand.
Zhang Yuan kept his feet down, raised his right hand to his chest, and punched the side of the spear pointed at him.
Mountain boxing technique, breaking mountains and sealing mountains.
